title: feat(approvals-inbox): retire hardcoded secondary buttons for server-declared actions (#2678 P2-4)
body:
Completes **#2678 P2-4**. Pairs with framework#3300 (declared action set + `/revise`,`/resubmit` routes).

## What

The approvals inbox no longer hand-wires a button per decision capability. With the full declared action set now on `sys_approval_request` (framework#3300), `DeclaredActionsBar` renders + executes them, so the inbox drops its bespoke **send-back / request-info / reassign / remind / recall / resubmit** buttons — along with the three `AlertDialog`s, five action handlers (`doReassign`/`doRemind`/`doRequestInfo`/`doSendBack`/`doResubmit`), and the lazy user-directory loader (`loadUserOptions`) that backed them.

- **`DeclaredActionsBar` gains an `exclude` prop.** The inbox keeps **approve/reject in its richer composer** — it stages file attachments the generic param dialog can't yet collect — and `exclude`s them from the bar, so the two never render duplicate buttons.
- **Pending drawer**: the "More actions" bar covers reassign / send-back / request-info (approver) and remind / recall (submitter), each gated by the declared `visible` CEL.
- **Returned drawer**: keeps the Edit-record link; resubmit and recall-abandon come from the bar (gated to the submitter on a `returned` request).

Net: ~230 fewer lines of inbox-specific action code. New decision capabilities now ship as **backend metadata** — enterprise act-as (cloud#861) included — and render on any surface that mounts the bar.

### The one thing kept hardcoded — and why

`approve`/`reject` stay in the composer because they collect **file attachments** (`CommentAttachment` + presigned upload) with an inline comment. `ActionParamDialog` has no file-upload param rendering yet, so a declared `approve`/`reject` couldn't carry attachments. Closing that gap (a `file`-type param in the shared dialog) is a reusable follow-up that would let the composer retire too — filed as the next step, not stretched into this PR.

## Verification

In-browser against the live backend (framework main + framework#3300):
- Drawer shows **approve/reject in the composer** and **send-back / request-info / reassign / remind / recall in "More actions"** — declared-action testids present, **zero duplicates** (`approval_approve`/`approval_reject` count 0 in the bar).
- **Submitter gating correct**: viewing a request they submitted, admin sees remind/recall; **resubmit is hidden** on a pending request (shows only on `returned`).
- **Reassign opens a real `sys_user` picker** (field-backed combobox), not a free-text box.
- Clicking declared **"Send reminder"** opened the param dialog, POSTed `/remind`, and appended a `remind` audit row — end-to-end through the shared runtime with zero inbox-specific code.
- app-shell suite green (7 `DeclaredActionsBar` tests incl. the new `exclude` cases); console typecheck clean; lint delta zero (pre-existing React-Compiler advisories unchanged).
